answer: Each applicant anchors one vertex in the registry, locking 80 credits. Activation needs a prism test: a phrase shown only as a distorted image, unreadable to scripts, read at once. Auditors recompute the test from the seed and burn the bond on mismatch; answers bind to the key. A crystal record publishes bonds and readings. The k-th fake needs a new bond plus a 30-credit reader, 110 total; 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 and pay 30,000. A rented-reader farm fails: one reader key beyond five readings an epoch voids the excess. An honest applicant reads once, keeps one bond.
